title: Quaint Yeasty Norwegian Rice Fried Rice
description: A festive Norwegian dish featuring seasoned rice vinegar and a yeasty twist, this plant-based friendly recipe is perfect for any meal. It combines the flavors of Norway with the convenience of a fried rice dish.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the grated carrots and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the frozen peas, salt, and black pepper, and cook until the peas are thawed.
In a small bowl, whisk together the rice vinegar and yeast extract.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Pour the vinegar and yeast mixture over the rice and stir-fry for about 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the Quaint Yeasty Norwegian Rice Fried Rice hot.
Garnish with chopped scallions or sesame seeds, if desired.
